headline: Enhanced reflections, clearer level editing and fixes for drones and co-op
summary: Enhanced rendering gained baked environment reflections for water and authored chrome and glass materials. The launcher now guides players through level editing with one status panel and offers a way to start extraction over. Ratchet & Clank fixes restore Drone Device spawning and correct Novalis sparks, while co-op work keeps the world available under pause menus and fixes remote glove animation. Mod support gained persistent savestate APIs and Android native mod builds.
highlights: Baked reflections and probe placement cover playable rooms, corridors, jumps and swimming areas (#119).
The editor gains a guided status panel, reset controls and PAL custom ship destinations (#104, #105, #107).
Drone spawning and Novalis sparks are corrected; native mods gain Android support (#110).
Co-op world access survives pause menus, and remote gloves animate with their hands (#99, #120).
Persistent savestate support lands through mod interface 1.10, followed by SDK 1.10.1 for Android (#103, #117).
The Development update channel now follows develop (#111).
